People: Aleksandr Sergeevich Pushkin (author, Wikidata Q7200), died 1837; Louis Delâtre (translator, Wikidata Q12815148), died 1893. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Pushkin, Aleksandr Sergeevich, 1799-1837; Delâtre, Louis, 1815-1893 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Racconti poetici di Alessandro Puschin, poeta russo , Felice Le Monnier, 1856, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_zrWpHqCKGZwC. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 87%, 58%, 65% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Aleksandr Sergeevich Pushkin, Louis Delâtre, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
